cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)
project(champ_base)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(champ_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(sensor_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(trajectory_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(tf2 REQUIRED)
find_package(urdf REQUIRED)
find_package(champ REQUIRED)
include_directories(include ${champ_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${champ_INCLUDE_DIRS}/champ/)
add_library(quadruped_controller SHARED src/quadruped_controller.cpp)
ament_target_dependencies(quadruped_controller rclcpp champ_msgs geometry_msgs std_msgs sensor_msgs trajectory_msgs tf2 urdf champ)
add_executable(quadruped_controller_node src/quadruped_controller_node.cpp)
target_link_libraries(quadruped_controller_node quadruped_controller)
ament_target_dependencies(quadruped_controller_node rclcpp champ_msgs geometry_msgs std_msgs sensor_msgs trajectory_msgs tf2 urdf champ)
install(TARGETS quadruped_controller LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(TARGETS quadruped_controller_node DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
ament_export_include_directories(include)
ament_export_dependencies(rclcpp champ_msgs geometry_msgs std_msgs sensor_msgs trajectory_msgs tf2 urdf champ)
ament_package()
